actual_request_and_key.actual_request: How can uncarried Eggs be destroyed with Shoot/Melee, grenades, Molotov and Fire; which Melee penalties are waived, when is Noise rolled and when is the Nest destroyed?
actual_request_and_key.actual_key: Each Injury from Shoot/Melee destroys 1 uncarried Egg. Successful Egg Melee retains the ordinary draw of 1 Contamination card onto the Action discard pile. On a missed Egg Melee, no Contamination card and no Wound are suffered. The sources do not specify how the normal pre-roll draw and miss waiver are reconciled; no refund or delayed draw is invented. Grenade destroys 2 Eggs, Molotov 1; Noise after every destruction attempt including miss. Fire destroys 1 uncarried Egg each Fire Damage step. Nest destroyed once all its Eggs taken/destroyed; mark Injury in Nest.

detailed_exceptions.assessment: English p25 places if they miss at the end of the no-Contamination/no-Wound sentence; PL/FR p25 explicitly condition both waivers on a miss. The fixed key correctly retains the successful-Melee Contamination branch while refusing to invent how the normal pre-roll draw is reconciled with a later miss. This bounded result must not become a demand for an invented refund/delay procedure. DE p25 is not used as an English erratum.

new_proposals.proposed_stem: Before a Contamination card has been Scanned, is its INFECTED/not-INFECTED status known to its player? When an effect instructs a Scan, how is that status read, and does a coded word merely resembling INFECTED count?
new_proposals.proposed_key: The infection status is hidden by the patterned field and remains unknown until the card is Scanned (including the endgame scan). Place the Scanner's red foil over the coded field. If the exact word INFECTED appears in one of the text lines, the card is Infected; if it does not, it is not Infected. Similar-looking coded words do not suffice. Resolve the additional effect specified by the particular scanning Action/Room/Item; this question does not grant a free Scan or override those procedures.

raw_primary_references.location: right column Contamination cards, hidden-information paragraph
raw_primary_references.primary_passage: Each Contamination card contains hidden information: the Character may be INFECTED or not. This information is hidden by colorful patterns in the text field. Unless the card is “Scanned”, this information remains unknown to the player until the end of the game.

raw_primary_references.location: upper-left column, continuation of Scanning and removing Contamination cards
raw_primary_references.primary_passage: Take the Scanner and place its red foil part over the coded field of the Contamination card you’re Scanning. In one of the lines of text, the word INFECTED may appear. If not, the card is NOT INFECTED. Note: Look closely at the cards, because some of the coded words may be seemingly similar to INFECTED.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: Contrast Canteen/Shower scanning with Surgery: which cards are scanned and removed, how is a Larva handled, and what costs or turn consequences follow Surgery?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Canteen/Shower optionally scan hand Contamination, remove non-Infected; infected gives Larva and retains card, existing Larva means death/Creeper. Canteen heals 1 Light; Shower removes Slime. Surgery scans deck/hand/discard, removes infected and Larva, then 1 Light Wound, automatic pass, shuffle all cards including hand into deck; empty hand until next turn.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: Give the endgame checks in order. What happens with two Damaged Engines, a non-Earth destination (including Quarantine/Mars), and an infected survivor or one carrying a Larva? Do pod passengers need Contamination checks?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Engines then Coordinates then Contamination then Objectives. If ship survives to checks: two/three Damaged explodes kills all aboard incl Intruders; non-Earth kills sleepers but ship/Intruders survive, Quarantine sleeper survives Mars. All survivors including launched pod passengers scan all Contamination; any infected triggers shuffle all Action/Contamination draw 4, any Contamination kills else survives. Larva skips scanning and directly does shuffle/draw. Survivors then reveal/check chosen Objective.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: At the final Contamination check, a survivor has no Larva and every Contamination card scans non-Infected. Must they perform the four-card draw or remove those cards, and does an earlier launched Pod escape the Objective check?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: No four-card draw unless infected found or Larva on board; end scan does not instruct removing non-infected. Pod passenger still needs surviving Contamination check and chosen Objective fulfillment.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: Rest scans several Infected cards while no Larva was on your board. Can the scan kill you from multiple infected cards; when can Rest be fatal?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: No; place one Larva regardless number infected. Can be fatal only if a Larva already was on board before Rest.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: Alcohol scans an Infected Contamination card. Does this place a Larva and what happens instead?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: No Larva from this result; take a new Contamination card.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: Describe Antidote: scan scope, removed cards, new Contamination, reshuffling, hand retention and passing; how does Surgery differ?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Scan all Contamination from hand/deck/discard, remove all Infected from game, take one new Contamination, reshuffle it with all non-Infected scanned Contamination and Action cards except cards left in hand, then pass. May retain hand cards. Surgery instead shuffles entire hand too and does not gain extra Contamination (and its own wound/removal procedure still applies). Antidote also removes a Larva already on the Character board.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: When you use Canteen or Shower, what non-scanning benefit does each Room give? Must you choose between that benefit and scanning Contamination, or can one Room Action give both? May you take the non-scanning benefit without choosing to scan?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Canteen heals 1 Light Wound. Shower discards your Slime marker if you have one. Each additionally permits you to choose to scan all Contamination cards in your hand and remove all non-Infected cards; that scan is optional and additional to the Room benefit, not an OR replacement. You may take the non-scanning benefit without scanning. If you do scan, resolve the infected/Larva consequences as normal. Pay the ordinary single Room Action cost, subject to common Room restrictions.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: You roll a number for a Corridor already holding Noise, with a Technical Corridors Entrance in your Room. Give the Encounter sequence, Noise removal, token destination and Surprise Attack comparison; do Contamination cards count?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Resolve Encounter: remove all connected Noise including Technical Corridors; draw bag token; place matching Intruder; compare token number to all cards in triggering hand including Contamination. Fewer cards causes Surprise Attack against triggerer, equal or more does not. Set token aside.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: In an ordinary Intruder Attack with several Characters, how is the target chosen and ties broken; how is a hit determined; what changes for Larva and where does its Contamination go?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Fewest Action cards in hand; tie First Player or next in turn order. Matching attacker symbol on drawn Attack card means resolve effect; otherwise miss; ignore blood and discard card. Larva draws no Attack card: place miniature on target Character board and give Contamination on top of Action discard.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: When are Action hands refilled and the First Player token passed; what happens when the Action deck empties, and what are the normal discard destinations and visibility?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: At Player Phase start draw to 5, shuffle Action discard whenever required draw finds empty deck; then pass token left except first turn. Actions/Contamination to own Action discard, Items/Event/Attack/Serious Wounds to respective discard piles face up; markers to pools. Search example has explicit face-down return exception.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: Which Items may be hidden, what do other players see, what is the Inventory limit, and what must happen on use? How are Heavy Items/Objects, added Items and Duct Tape handled?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Normal Items hidden in unlimited Inventory, others see backs/colors; used Item shown. Heavy Items/Objects public in two Hands, third requires dropping one. Added Items act as one with base card. Duct Tape combines two Heavy Items into one Hand, never Objects.

new_proposals.novelty_rationale: A player can know all existing scope/removal/Larva/final-check answers while treating face-up patterned infection as known information or accepting a near-match coded word. Q127 tests the source-defined transition from hidden to classified infection information. It adds neither another scan carrier nor a changed cost/dose, and does not duplicate a fact actually asked but missing from a key.
new_proposals.restraint: No particular physical Contamination card is decoded here; no unsupported scanner legality/timing or free-scan permission is asserted.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: Can Medkit and Bandages be used on other Characters?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Yes, both.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: At three Serious Wounds, does dressing one prevent death from a Light Wound? What happens at a third Light Wound otherwise, what does Heal remove, and where do a dead Characters Corpse and Heavy Objects go?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: No: dressed still counts; any further Wound kills at three Serious. Third Light clears Light track and causes Serious Wound. Heal removes specified Light Wound or discards dressed Serious card. Place Corpse and drop Heavy Objects in death Room.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: What are the three mutually exclusive Emergency Room treatments; does dressing remove the Wound or merely its effect, and do identical Serious Wound effects stack?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Dress all Serious OR heal one dressed Serious OR heal all Light. Dress flips/ignores effect but retains Serious count; identical Serious effects do not stack.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: Outside Combat, what can a single use of Bandages do to Wounds, and what two alternatives does Clothes offer? Can Bandages heal an undressed Serious Wound directly? Give each Item's Action-card cost and whether its alternatives can be combined in one use.
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Bandages costs 1 Action card and either dresses 1 Serious Wound OR heals all Light Wounds. It does not directly heal/discard an undressed Serious Wound. Clothes costs 1 Action card and either discards a Slime marker OR dresses 1 Serious Wound. Choose one effect per Item use; both are Out of Combat Only and One Use Only, so discard the used Item.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: You use an Action card with printed cost 2 while holding that card, two other Action cards and two Contamination cards. What is discarded, and can Contamination substitute for payment? What if the card offers OR effects?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Discard the played card and two additional Action cards face up. Contamination cannot pay costs. Choose one OR effect.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: What defines being in Combat, how do In Combat Only and Out of Combat Only restrictions work, and may an unmarked Action or Item be used in either situation? Do Eggs cause Combat?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Sharing Room with Intruder defines Combat, not Eggs. In Combat Only requires it, Out of Combat Only requires none. Unmarked card/Item actions can be used in either subject to requirements; Basic Actions in Combat are limited to Shoot, Melee and Basic Movement as Escape. No Room Actions or Quest activation in Combat.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: You perform the Action printed on a One Use Only Item. Besides paying its Action-card cost and showing it, what happens to the Item card after use?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Discard the Item card to the appropriate Item discard pile after using it. This is in addition to discarding the Action cards needed to pay its Action cost.

Under the stipulated novelty rule the different carrier and dose/menu subset do not suffice. Do not revive Q124.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: After every player has had one round of two Actions, does the Event Phase begin automatically? Describe who takes the next round, the order and size of rounds while players remain active, what happens when a player takes only one Action or none, and exactly when the Player Phase ends.
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Starting with the First Player, proceed clockwise, each active player taking a round of 2 Actions. After everyone has had a round, repeat rounds in that order while at least one player has not passed. Taking only 1 Action requires passing; taking none or being unable to act requires passing. Players who have passed are skipped for ordinary later Actions in this Player Phase; the FAQ permits Interruption after passing. Begin the Event Phase only after all players have passed.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: A Character in a burning Room takes one Action then passes. When do they take Fire damage, can they act again this Player Phase, can they discard cards, and do later players rounds burn them again?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: At end of own round take 1 Light Wound. Passing bars normal Actions this Player Phase, but official FAQ permits Interruption after passing. May discard any number of hand cards on passing. No further Fire wounds from later players rounds this turn.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: When are Action hands refilled and the First Player token passed; what happens when the Action deck empties, and what are the normal discard destinations and visibility?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: At Player Phase start draw to 5, shuffle Action discard whenever required draw finds empty deck; then pass token left except first turn. Actions/Contamination to own Action discard, Items/Event/Attack/Serious Wounds to respective discard piles face up; markers to pools. Search example has explicit face-down return exception.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: Give the Event Phase order, which Intruders move on an Event card, what controls movement and when the event effect resolves; what happens when Event and Intruder Attack decks run out?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Time and active Self-Destruct advance, Intruders in Combat attack, Fire Damage, Event card movement then effect, bag development fully resolved before next turn. Move symbol-matching Intruders without Characters in Room via card-number Corridor; ducts remove miniature/return token. Discard Event unless instructed otherwise. Empty Event/Attack decks reshuffle their respective discard piles.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: After two Actions your hand is empty. Do you automatically pass then, and what timing consequence can Fire or Bleeding have?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: No automatic pass. Wait for next round to pass; can suffer Fire/Bleeding again because passing ends another round.

bounded_accept_reject_ledger.reason: Q125 directly requests the repeated clockwise two-Action loop and all-passed transition. Its distinction from individual pass timing is valid, and now already tested. No further example adds a procedure.

bounded_accept_reject_ledger.candidate: Another Canteen/Shower combined-benefit question after Q126

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: When you use Canteen or Shower, what non-scanning benefit does each Room give? Must you choose between that benefit and scanning Contamination, or can one Room Action give both? May you take the non-scanning benefit without choosing to scan?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Canteen heals 1 Light Wound. Shower discards your Slime marker if you have one. Each additionally permits you to choose to scan all Contamination cards in your hand and remove all non-Infected cards; that scan is optional and additional to the Room benefit, not an OR replacement. You may take the non-scanning benefit without scanning. If you do scan, resolve the infected/Larva consequences as normal. Pay the ordinary single Room Action cost, subject to common Room restrictions.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: Contrast Canteen/Shower scanning with Surgery: which cards are scanned and removed, how is a Larva handled, and what costs or turn consequences follow Surgery?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Canteen/Shower optionally scan hand Contamination, remove non-Infected; infected gives Larva and retains card, existing Larva means death/Creeper. Canteen heals 1 Light; Shower removes Slime. Surgery scans deck/hand/discard, removes infected and Larva, then 1 Light Wound, automatic pass, shuffle all cards including hand into deck; empty hand until next turn.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: Does entering Room Covered With Slime require an Action to acquire Slime, can it have an Item Counter or Malfunction, can Slime stack, and does showering extinguish Fire?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Entry automatically gives Slime; no paid Action. No Item Counter, never Malfunction. Max one Slime, extra does nothing; Clothes/Shower remove. Shower does not remove Fire and Fire allowed there. On first entering the Room Covered With Slime, acquire Slime before resolving its Exploration token. Thus a Silence Exploration effect becomes Danger on that first entry, subject to the already-covered Careful Movement/Reconnaissance cancellation.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: What are the three mutually exclusive Emergency Room treatments; does dressing remove the Wound or merely its effect, and do identical Serious Wound effects stack?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Dress all Serious OR heal one dressed Serious OR heal all Light. Dress flips/ignores effect but retains Serious count; identical Serious effects do not stack.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: Outside Combat, what can a single use of Bandages do to Wounds, and what two alternatives does Clothes offer? Can Bandages heal an undressed Serious Wound directly? Give each Item's Action-card cost and whether its alternatives can be combined in one use.
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Bandages costs 1 Action card and either dresses 1 Serious Wound OR heals all Light Wounds. It does not directly heal/discard an undressed Serious Wound. Clothes costs 1 Action card and either discards a Slime marker OR dresses 1 Serious Wound. Choose one effect per Item use; both are Out of Combat Only and One Use Only, so discard the used Item.

bounded_accept_reject_ledger.reason: Q126 explicitly requests principal benefit plus optional scan and declining the scan. This is a real additive-versus-OR distinction, now covered; additional hand/wound/Slime compositions would repeat it.

bounded_accept_reject_ledger.candidate: Separate Fire Control target-in-Combat and retreating Door question

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: How does Fire Control affect a chosen Room and its Intruders if the Room has Fire, or has none?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Choose any one Room, remove Fire if present; all its Intruders flee random directions, one Event card drawn per Intruder. Works with no Fire.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: A retreating Intruder meets a Closed Door. What happens normally, and what changes under The Way of Moving Weakness for an affected non-Breeder/non-Queen?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Normally destroys Door and stays in Room; with that Weakness for an affected Intruder other than Breeder/Queen nothing happens at all.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: Two Intruders attempt to move together from the same Room through one Closed Door. Where do they end, what happens to the Door, can it later close, and would a Noise-triggered appearance be blocked by that Door?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Both stay in original Room and destroy Door simultaneously. Destroyed Door permits movement but cannot close except Plasma Torch. Noise-triggered appearance ignores Closed Door.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: What are the common prerequisites and cost for Room Actions, what does a Computer icon itself do, and how does Fire affect Room Actions or Searching?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Cost two Action cards, Character in matching Room unless explicit special ability, no Combat or Malfunction. Computer icon only significant when another rule references it, unavailable under Malfunction. Fire alone bars neither Room Action nor Search.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: Which Basic Actions can be used in Combat; can you Trade, Craft or Pick Up an Object there? What about permitted card or Item Actions?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Only Basic Shoot, Melee, or Basic Movement as Escape. No Trade/Craft/PickUp, no Room Action or Quest activation. Card/Item actions without Out of Combat restriction may be used subject to own requirements.

bounded_accept_reject_ledger.reason: Q38 requests the full chosen-Room/Intruder effect and keys all Intruders fleeing with or without Fire; the target may be any Room. FAQ Rooms8 confirms its Combat reach. Q68/Q10 already request the Door collision outcome. This does not add a distinct resolution beyond the actual general procedure and its existing Door exception.

bounded_accept_reject_ledger.candidate: Basic Repairs/Knowledge of Ship/Flashlight or Plasma Torch carrier/cost variants

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: You use an Action card with printed cost 2 while holding that card, two other Action cards and two Contamination cards. What is discarded, and can Contamination substitute for payment? What if the card offers OR effects?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Discard the played card and two additional Action cards face up. Contamination cannot pay costs. Choose one OR effect.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: What does a Malfunction disable and leave usable, where can it never be placed, and does it change an Engine token or harm an already-hibernating Character?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Disables Room Action and Computer; Search still works. Never in Nest or Room Covered In Slime. Special Rooms can malfunction; Engine Working/Damaged unaffected and already-hibernating Characters unaffected. Repair cards/Tools can remove marker.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: How does Engine checking differ from repairing/breaking; what can stay secret, what must be announced and do you need a prior check or functioning Engine Room?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Check secretly top token only may lie. Repairs Action or Tools permits take both tokens secretly restack any order. Need announce whether order changed, not whether repaired. Works without prior check and despite Malfunction. Top true status, two Working needed.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: When you use Nemesis Plans, how many unexplored Room tiles may you check, may you also inspect their Exploration tokens as with Monitoring Room, and what are the Item's Action-card cost and use restrictions?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Check any 2 unexplored Room tiles, but do not look at their Exploration tokens. Pay 1 Action card; the Item is One Use Only and Out of Combat Only, so discard it after use. Monitoring Room instead checks 1 unexplored Room tile together with its Exploration token.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: When you use your own Energy Charge, how much Ammo may it restore and to what type of Weapon? What alternative Door effect can you choose, and which Doors are in range?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Either fully load one of your own Energy Weapons (up to its capacity), OR Open or Close 1 Door in a Corridor connected to your current Room. The Door alternative does not also reload a Weapon. The Item has no Combat restriction icon, so it may be used in or out of Combat subject to its own requirements. It costs 1 Action card and is One Use Only. The ordinary prohibition on closing Destroyed Doors still applies; Energy Charge is not the Plasma Torch exception.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: How does Search choose its deck, draw and keep cards, return the rejected card, change the Item Counter, and handle zero Items, Special Rooms and Blue Items?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Search Action: choose one matching Red/Yellow/Green deck, white may choose any ONE, draw two, keep one, put rejected card at BOTTOM of same deck, not shuffle. Lower counter one, zero prevents Search except e.g. Scavenging; Special Rooms cannot Search. Blue Items only Craft.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: Two Intruders attempt to move together from the same Room through one Closed Door. Where do they end, what happens to the Door, can it later close, and would a Noise-triggered appearance be blocked by that Door?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Both stay in original Room and destroy Door simultaneously. Destroyed Door permits movement but cannot close except Plasma Torch. Noise-triggered appearance ignores Closed Door.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: Can Command Center select a distant Room and individually open some Doors and close others, including a Destroyed Door?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Choose any one Room and individually open/close any connected Doors, need not all same. Destroyed Door cannot close except Plasma Torch.

bounded_accept_reject_ledger.reason: Readable examples change carrier, cost, number of tiles or reusable local Door operation; requested repair/status, tile-without-token, Search and Destroyed Door exception already supply the operative branches. No additional independent procedure is established.

raw_primary_references.location: sample Action/Item cards and Basic Repairs example

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: At three Serious Wounds, does dressing one prevent death from a Light Wound? What happens at a third Light Wound otherwise, what does Heal remove, and where do a dead Characters Corpse and Heavy Objects go?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: No: dressed still counts; any further Wound kills at three Serious. Third Light clears Light track and causes Serious Wound. Heal removes specified Light Wound or discards dressed Serious card. Place Corpse and drop Heavy Objects in death Room.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: What are the three mutually exclusive Emergency Room treatments; does dressing remove the Wound or merely its effect, and do identical Serious Wound effects stack?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Dress all Serious OR heal one dressed Serious OR heal all Light. Dress flips/ignores effect but retains Serious count; identical Serious effects do not stack.

bounded_accept_reject_ledger.reason: FAQ Rules16 says the effect applies until dressed, the same effect-suppression procedure expressly asked by Q16/Q36 for Serious Wounds. The wound name adds no distinct exception.

bounded_accept_reject_ledger.candidate: Unspecified all-Adult-in-Combat fallback, Nest-reset or Egg-miss refund questions

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: You must place an Adult but all eight models are on board. What explicit procedure applies, and what if an Intruder enters an unexplored Room by movement?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Remove ALL Adults not in Combat and return corresponding tokens to bag if possible, then place Adult in Encounter Room. Moving Intruder into unexplored Room does not reveal Room/token and is not removed. If all eight are in Combat, the source supplies no executable resolution for freeing a model; do not invent one.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: How can uncarried Eggs be destroyed with Shoot/Melee, grenades, Molotov and Fire; which Melee penalties are waived, when is Noise rolled and when is the Nest destroyed?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Each Injury from Shoot/Melee destroys 1 uncarried Egg. Successful Egg Melee retains the ordinary draw of 1 Contamination card onto the Action discard pile. On a missed Egg Melee, no Contamination card and no Wound are suffered. The sources do not specify how the normal pre-roll draw and miss waiver are reconciled; no refund or delayed draw is invented. Grenade destroys 2 Eggs, Molotov 1; Noise after every destruction attempt including miss. Fire destroys 1 uncarried Egg each Fire Damage step. Nest destroyed once all its Eggs taken/destroyed; mark Injury in Nest.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: In bag development, describe Larva, Creeper, Adult, Breeder and both Queen branches. Which tokens are removed or returned, who rolls Noise and when does the next turn begin?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Larva removed to token pool, add Adult; Creeper removed to pool, add Breeder. Adult/Breeder cause ordered Noise rolls excluding Combat; token returns. For Adult specifically, return token immediately BEFORE Noise so same token may be redrawn in an Encounter. Queen: Characters in Nest means Queen there and Encounter; otherwise including undiscovered Nest add Egg; return Queen. Fully resolve triggered effects before new turn.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: Take an Egg from the Intruder board and drop it back in the Nest Room. Does it restore the Nest Egg total for destruction purposes?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: No; dropped Egg is a normal Heavy Object in Room and no longer counts toward Nest hit points.

bounded_accept_reject_ledger.reason: The supplied governing sources do not supply unique further executable answers for these edge states. Q51/Q18 already expose their source limits. Do not create hypothetical answer keys or turn a source gap into scored coverage.

bounded_accept_reject_ledger.candidate: Language-only replacement of English Door overflow, Item discard or Queen inequality

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: If a Door token must be placed and none are in the pool, what happens? How are Open, Closed and Destroyed Doors represented, and may two Door tokens share one Corridor or be placed in Technical Corridors?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Take any Door token elsewhere on board and move to required Corridor. Open no token, Closed standing, Destroyed lying. Max one per Corridor; none in Technical Corridors.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: What happens to an Item versus an Object voluntarily dropped, when and at what Action cost may you drop, and how do found Weapons differ from starting Weapons in Ammo?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Drop freely during own turn no Action; Objects stay in Room, Items discarded/lost. Found Weapon has 1 Ammo versus starting fully loaded, neither exceeds capacity.

closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_request: After damage, how are Larva, Adult and Queen death checked, when is a Carcass placed, and what if a Queen check draws a Retreat arrow?
closest_actual_requests_and_keys.actual_key: Larva dies at 1 injury without Carcass. Adult draws one Attack card blood, dies if blood <= current injuries and leaves Carcass. Queen draws two, sums blood and compares same way; any Retreat arrow causes retreat via Event-card corridor number, discard Event, rather than normal numerical resolution. Any killed non-Larva Intruder, including Queen, leaves a Carcass in its death Room; Larva does not.

bounded_accept_reject_ledger.reason: DE p17 narrows replacement to closed Doors; PL/FR p22 have different unused-Item bottom-of-deck wording; FR p20 uses a strict Queen/Breeder inequality. These cannot overrule EN p17/p20/p22 and FAQ Items8. Existing English-key branches remain governing.

closure.statement: The exact124 bank supports its existing requested branches within the supplied governing corpus, with no mandatory key repair identified. It does not directly request the general Contamination hidden-status/scan-classification boundary in EN pp20–21. Accept Q127 above as the one distinct addition found in this bounded whole-source review; preserve Q109/Q124 reservations. Do not call the124 bank saturated before adjudicating that proposal.
closure.after_proposal: No other qualifying addition found during this bounded review. Acceptance of Q127 would close this review's identified gap, not establish completeness of all physical cards or all hypothetical game states.

limitations.coverage_not_source_or_playability_compl: Assessment concerns requested facts in readable supplied core/scoped FAQ. It does not certify a complete card corpus, completely executable rules for every state, or all physical-card clauses.
limitations.legibility: Illustration labels or partial tiny clauses do not authorize reconstruction of full cards. No full Grenade/Prototype/tiny Wound/Weakness clause was invented. Relevant readable card panels and source prose were used only to their legible extent.
limitations.publisher_gaps: All-eight-Adults-in-Combat fallback and conditional Egg-Melee pre-roll/miss reconciliation remain unresolved. Later-death re-unlock/Nest reset or other hypothetical disputed states were not assigned new rulings.
limitations.authority: English manual plus scoped official FAQ govern. Compatible localization detail is supplemental; incompatible translation wording is not English errata.
limitations.question_vs_key: Volunteered unrequested context (including Q45 first-entry ordering and Q17 Room benefits) is not automatically a separate requested grading branch.
limitations.review_bound: One fresh bounded independent review, without an absent physical-card hunt or attempts to solve publisher gaps; no claim of unlimited state-space saturation.
